text.tspan: At release: 52,310 km · fuel 3/4 · Small scratch on rear bumper; spare tire, jack and early warning device included
At return: 52,480 km · fuel 3/4 · driven 170 km
Return condition: New scratch on the left door
The renter reported: The scratch on the left door was already there at pickup
of the ₱8,000.00 deposit: Repaint of a new scratch on the left door (shop quotation attached)
The renter disputes: The scratch is already visible in the left-side photo taken at release
ZamMove decided: keep ₱1,500.00. Only the lower scratch is new; the upper one is in the release photo
Deposit settlement: ₱8,000.00 deposit − ₱1,500.00 kept for the claim =
Rental ₱5,400.00 + deposit ₱5,000.00 · Verified paid ₱0.00 · ₱5,000.00 waiting for cashier ·
Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
Pay the full ₱10,400.00 before pickup. The first ₱5,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.
